reason: The beds need a structure on the growing-room floor; steel is the apparent framing material.
expectation: The steel will form or support the shared bed structure.

effect: The steel made raised frames with outlets above the future reservoir; they still need lining.
reaction: The different bed depths make the food plan more concrete.
reason: The food-safe sheet is the obvious lining for the new frames.
expectation: The sheet will line the shared bed structure.

effect: The lined beds have open drain stubs, and the next goal is to return water through the reservoir.
reaction: The distinction between structural support and a watertight liner is clear.
reason: The service hose should connect the open drains to the reservoir and pump.
expectation: The hose will connect the reservoir to the bed drains or prepare it for connection.

effect: The hoses are attached to the beds, but their common outlet still needs the reservoir beneath it.
reaction: The automatic correction clarified the connection order.
reason: The reservoir and pump should attach beneath the loose drain outlet.
expectation: The reservoir will be mounted beneath the beds and connected to their drains.

effect: The reservoir is connected beneath the beds, completing the aerated water-return goal and the chapter.
reaction: The falling return water mixing in oxygen was a satisfying, practical detail.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the reservoir was most worthwhile: it completed the system and explained how the return drop aerates water without another machine.

leastWorthwhile.text: The hose connection was a little confusing because I tried attaching it to the reservoir first, though the automatic correction kept things moving.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the hose had to be attached to the bed drains before the reservoir was mounted.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the correction established a connection order, even if it was not initially obvious.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see the empty beds put to use; the practical explanations made building the system interesting.
